slides.title: Har business ko *1 lead sheet* chahiye. Bas 6 columns.
slides.sub: Diary aur WhatsApp chats mein leads kho jaati hain. Google Sheet free hai.

slides.title: 1. *Date* + 2. *Naam/number*
slides.sub: Basic lagta hai. Par bahut dukaanon mein ye bhi kahin likha nahi hota.

slides.title: 3. *Kahan se* aaya
slides.sub: Insta, Google, walk-in, referral. Mahine baad pata chalega paisa kahan lagana hai.

slides.title: 4. *Kya chahiye*
slides.sub: Ek line. Next call pe customer ko lagega aapko yaad hai.

slides.title: 5. *Status* + 6. *Next date*
slides.sub: Status: Naya / Baat hui / Booked / Nahi. Aur agla follow-up kab.

slides.title: Roz *5 minute*
slides.sub: Subah sheet kholo, "next date = aaj" filter karo. Wahi log call karo.

slides.title: Ye sheet *apne aap* bhare?
slides.sub: Comment SHEET: free template + auto-fill kaise hota hai

caption:
Leads diary mein, WhatsApp mein, staff ke phone mein. Aur mahine ke end mein pata nahi kaun reh gaya. 📒

Lead sheet ke 6 columns:
1️⃣ Date
2️⃣ Naam + number
3️⃣ Kahan se aaya
4️⃣ Kya chahiye
5️⃣ Status
6️⃣ Next follow-up date

Roz subah 5 min: "next date = aaj" filter, wahi log call karo.

Save karo 🔖
Comment "SHEET" 👇 free template.
